items.term: past simple for finished actions (I called her yesterday)

example.en: We visited the museum last Sunday.
example.es: Visitamos el museo el domingo pasado.

items.term: past continuous for the background (It was raining)
items.es: pasado continuo: lo que estaba pasando (el contexto de una historia)

example.en: It was raining and the streets were empty.
example.es: Estaba lloviendo y las calles estaban vacías.

items.term: was doing… when… did (I was cooking when he called)
items.es: una acción en curso interrumpida por otra

example.en: I was cooking when my sister called.
example.es: Estaba cocinando cuando llamó mi hermana.

items.term: while + past continuous (while I was reading)

example.en: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
example.es: Mientras caminaba a casa, empezó a llover.

items.term: past simple for actions in a row (I got up, had a shower and left)
items.es: pasado simple: acciones seguidas, una después de otra

example.en: She got up, had a shower and left the house.
example.es: Se levantó, se duchó y salió de la casa.

items.es: en ese momento, en esa época

example.en: At that time, I was living in Chicago.
example.es: En esa época, yo vivía en Chicago.

passages.title: A strange night
passages.text: Last Friday, I was walking home from work. It was dark and it was raining a little. While I was crossing the park, I heard a strange noise behind me. I stopped and turned around. A small dog was following me! It didn't have a collar, so I took it home and gave it some water. The next day, I saw a poster with its photo in the park. I called the number on the poster, and the owner came to get it an hour later.
